what: kind4-spec C1: the default monitor build's replies and console for one fixed corpus (tests/monitor_corpus.py), captured from main at 4ee3e532. Replayed by tests/test_monitor_golden.py.

reference.how: each source exported with 'git show 4ee3e532:<path>' on the Windows side, never from a checkout; its git blob id (git hash-object --no-filters) recomputed at capture and checked against 'git ls-tree 4ee3e532'

build.gcc_version_from: the first line of 'gcc --version' (the rest is the licence notice)

left_out.shmkick: needs the ivshmem server and a kick client; its banner carries a server-assigned peer id, and its burst and done lines count on timing
left_out.kind 4: kind4-spec C2 runs this corpus through the vss build, where kind 4 gets a real verdict; C7 pins it

normalised: the file path in 'serving shm on file %s,' -> '<shm-file>'
stamp mode: payload[8..23] (t_in, t_out) of a reply to a claim -> 'x', only when 0 < t_in <= t_out
capture.redacted: the hostname -> <host> and the login name -> <user>, in either case and inside paths, and /home/<user> (the repo's rule: no host identity in anything recorded); none appeared
capture.stdout_stderr: lists of lines, each with its newline, decoded as ASCII; joined they are the bytes printed
